body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #333

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed branch `bb/relay-127-mcp-integration-06-07-manage-project-m-thr_dggg25qrdi` to origin.

## Summary

Implements issue #127: management of project-level MCP tool grants (the "Tools block").

- **Backend** (`@semprec/data`): `mcpAgentPageGrants.ts` adds the read model (`listMcpToolGrantsForProject`, joining registrations with server identity and this project's grant, default unchecked) and write wrappers (`setProjectMcpGrantForAgentPage`, `reclassifyMcpTool`). These wrappers live inside the package so the admin-only mutations in `mcpGrantsAdminStore.ts` stay unreachable from `agent-runtime`'s public import surface — an existing security boundary in this codebase.
- **HTTP API** (`semprec-api`): `mcpAgentPageHandler.ts`, bearer-token authenticated, exposing GET/PATCH for project grants and PATCH for tool reclassification, routed alongside the existing AI-usage handler.
- **Frontend**: `mcpAgentPageOperations.ts` (zod-validated client) and `ToolsBlock.tsx`, a self-contained component grouping tools by server with a checkbox bound to the project's grant, plus risk-class/requires-approval controls. Covers loading, empty, error, transport-offline, mutation-error, and concurrent-refresh states with i18n labels in both catalogs (`en`/`cs`).

Note: no standalone "AGENT page" with guidance/heartbeats blocks exists yet in `web/src`, so this lands as a tested, drop-in component ready to be composed into that page once it's built, rather than fabricating the rest of that page's scope.

Verified in this run: backend build (all packages), dependency-boundary check, backend unit+integration tests (591 tests) and e2e tests (5 tests), web build, and web test suite (93 tests) — all passing.

Pull request: #333

Pushed to the same branch: `bb/relay-127-mcp-integration-06-07-manage-project-m-thr_dggg25qrdi`.

This push adds commit `df1430c`, which addresses the 4 medium-severity findings from the code-review CI check on PR #333:

1. `setProjectMcpGrant` now maps an unknown `mcpToolRegistrationId`'s foreign-key violation to a `NotFoundError` (404) instead of letting a raw Postgres error surface as a 500.
2. `readJsonBody` in `mcpAgentPageHandler.ts` now catches malformed JSON and raises a `ValidationError` (400) instead of a 500.
3. `ToolsBlock`'s `useMcpToolGrants` now guards against out-of-order network responses with a load-generation counter, fixing the concurrent-refresh race.
4. Corrected `ToolsBlock`'s JSDoc, which incorrectly claimed optimistic updates.

All fixes are covered by new/updated tests. Full verification in this run: backend build (all packages), dependency-boundary check, backend unit (83), integration (594), and e2e (5) tests, plus web build and test suite (94) — all passing.

Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-127-mcp-integration-06-07-manage-project-m-thr_dggg25qrdi` (`df1430c..26f0d64`).

This push addresses the latest code-review round on PR #333:
- **AC #1 (was ❌ Unmet — "ToolsBlock.tsx is created but never imported or rendered in any AGENT page component")**: added `web/src/views/agentPage/AgentPage.tsx`, a project AGENT page that renders a Guidance section (from the project item's `agents` property), a Heartbeats placeholder (a real list-by-project heartbeats read needs a module registry that `semprec-api` doesn't currently have access to — confirmed via grep — so that's out of scope here), and mounts `ToolsBlock` below both. Wired in via a new `?page=agent&project=<id>&database=<id>` composition-root route in `main.tsx`/`App.tsx`, mirroring the existing `?page=ai-usage` pattern. Covered by 7 new tests in `AgentPage.test.tsx`.
- **Remaining open medium finding** (missing test coverage for `reclassifyMcpTool`): added riskClass-select, requiresApproval-checkbox, and per-row-error tests to `ToolsBlock.test.tsx`.

All checks passed this turn: web typecheck/tests/build, backend `check:boundaries`/build, and the full backend test suite (unit 83/83, integration 593-594/594 with one confirmed-flaky, unrelated Postgres-deadlock test that passes in isolation, e2e 5/5).

Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-127-mcp-integration-06-07-manage-project-m-thr_dggg25qrdi` (`26f0d64..534a313`).

This push addresses the latest code-review round on PR #333, which reported all 17 acceptance criteria met but blocked on 1 medium finding plus 2 low-priority notes:

- **Medium finding**: `mcpAgentPageHandler.ts`'s `readJsonBody` buffered the entire request body into memory with no size cap, letting an authenticated caller exhaust server memory with an oversized payload. Now it enforces a 1 MiB limit while streaming and returns `413` once exceeded, with a new integration test covering it.
- **Low-priority note**: the post-mutation `refresh()` call in `ToolsBlock.tsx` now uses `void refresh()`, matching the initial load's floating-promise handling.
- **Low-priority note**: the `AgentPage.test.tsx` test titled "retries on demand" now actually clicks the retry button and asserts the retried `getItem` call succeeds, instead of only checking the initial error state.

All checks passed this turn: web typecheck/tests(104/104)/build, backend build/`check:boundaries`/unit(83/83)/integration(594-595/595, one confirmed pre-existing flaky test unrelated to this diff, passes 10/10 in isolation)/e2e(5/5).
